page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.4xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance within the Enhanced family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM. This configuration maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The CPU architecture includes 48 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction set extensions such as AVX-512, VNNI, AES, and SHA_NI running under a KVM hypervisor. The instance features no local disk storage and no GPU hardware accelerators, relying on network-attached storage while offering a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks position the instance within the average spectrum for general multi-core compute tasks. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 15550.89, a Geekbench multi-core score of 9594.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 21143.74. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 101.79 GB/sec, while write bandwidth reaches 57.38 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput reaches 21.46 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations process at 15.94 million operations per second. Hardware execution of small LLM text generation model (135M) yields 266.95 tokens per second, benefiting from VNNI instruction support.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation prioritizes processing density, making the instance efficient for workloads that require CPU capability without the overhead of unused memory capacity. Because persistent local storage is absent, storage performance relies entirely on remote disk attachments. The ecs.c7se.4xlarge is best suited for application backends, web serving, software build pipelines, continuous integration systems, and light artificial intelligence inference tasks.
